goal: Produce a complete spec for adding helical (spiral) CT scanning to BasisSimulator.jl that integrates seamlessly with the existing volume scan, physics pipeline, workspace pattern, and GPU-native architecture. The spec must be detailed enough that AI agents can implement it without guessing.

context.current_state: Axial scanning works end-to-end: forward projection (Siddon), 16-step physics chain, FDK+iterative reconstruction, PCCT support. CTProtocol already has n_rotations field (unused). CTGeometry hardcodes Z=0 for all source/detector positions.
context.architecture: 5-part API: phantom → scanner → protocol → sim_opts → recon_opts. Zero-allocation workspace pattern. AcceleratedKernels.jl for GPU-agnostic execution.
context.key_constraint: Must integrate seamlessly — same API pattern, same physics pipeline, same workspace zero-alloc model. NOT a separate code path.

topics.title: Current Geometry and Projection Audit — Where Z=0 Is Hardcoded
topics.description: FIRST TOPIC. Read through every file that touches geometry, source/detector positions, or Z-coordinates. Map exactly where the circular-orbit assumption is baked in.

topics.title: Helical CT Geometry — Table Motion, Pitch, and Coordinate Transforms
topics.description: Research helical CT geometry. Define: pitch, table feed per angle, Z(θ) formula, clinical pitch values, phantom coverage requirements.

topics.title: Helical Forward Projection — Siddon with Table Motion
topics.description: Verify Siddon ray tracer works unchanged for helical. Confirm polychromatic pipeline, GPU kernel, and PCCT path all work with helical geometry.

topics.title: Helical Reconstruction Algorithms — FDK-Helical vs Katsevich vs Rebinning
topics.description: Research and recommend helical reconstruction approach. WFBP recommended, Katsevich rejected. Includes GPU kernel pseudocode for weighted helical FDK. C1 RESOLVED: normalization is 2π/views_per_rotation.

topics.title: API Design — Seamless Helical in the 5-Part API
topics.description: CTProtocol pitch field, CTGeometry struct additions, workspace changes, dose formulas, validation rules. Complete change list (~25 sites across ~10 files). All inner constructor diffs provided.

topics.title: Physics Pipeline Compatibility — What Changes for Helical?
topics.description: Audit of all 16 physics effects. Result: ALL are helical-compatible with zero code changes. Physics is gantry-frame or element-wise.

topics.title: Reference Implementations — TIGRE, CatSim, ASTRA, RTK
topics.description: Survey how existing CT simulation frameworks implement helical scanning. Complete in Section 3.7b. XCIST and FreeCT_wFBP are the only open-source helical FBP implementations.

topics.title: Validation and Testing — How Do We Know Helical Works?
topics.description: 5-tier test strategy: unit (Z(θ), W(q̂)), axial regression, helical integration, quality metrics (HU/noise/z-uniformity), cross-reference (XCIST, converged SIRT). 16 test cases with code. Section 7 in spec.

topics.title: SYNTHESIS: Helical CT Implementation Roadmap
topics.description: Complete Section 8 with 3 implementation stories, exact before/after diffs for all ~25 change sites, WFBP GPU kernel code, dependency graph, risk assessment. ~350 lines production code, ~200 lines tests.
